narration.text: The reel is real in the source record. This panel is a decoded copy. Its file is three hundred and twenty pixels wide. That does not tell us the width of the physical film.
The red box is my selection, not an original production mark. It excludes the face. The physical gauge of the pictured film remains unresolved.
This derivative follows that box. One hundred ninety two by one hundred twelve source pixels become forty eight by twenty eight. The blocks are a new sampling decision, not recovered grain.
One record becomes a selection, then a lower resolution file. They share a parent. They no longer carry the same detail.

end: images removed from digital table; pixel rulers and new red mark remain
